ns2:course.label: Materials Design
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MSE 494. Design teams evaluate alternatives, finalize concepts, model and analyze solutions, build and test a final product (physical or digital), and present the results professionally. Solutions are based on the knowledge, skills, and design experience acquired in earlier course work and incorporate realistic constraints. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Credit in MSE 494.
